pages.title: Nick Wilde Wearing His Hawaiian Shirt and Striped Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde wears his Hawaiian shirt and striped tie in this printable coloring page, standing with his paws in his pockets before Zootopia's curving towers and viaduct. Large flowers and leaves cover the short-sleeved shirt above plain trousers. The coloring sheet includes his sweeping tail, pointed ears, and smaller skyline details.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Carrying a Jumbo-pop Outside Jumbeaux's Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde carrying a Jumbo-pop outside Jumbeaux's Cafe, holding the oversized paw-shaped treat beneath an elephant-head sign above the storefront entrance. He wears a floral shirt and striped tie beside potted plants. The coloring sheet combines large paw-pad sections with small shirt flowers and pavement lines.

pages.title: Nick Wilde and Finnick Freezing Pawpsicles in Tundratown Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde and Finnick freeze pawpsicles in Tundratown in this printable coloring page, pouring liquid from pitchers into paw-shaped molds arranged on an icy table together. Snowbanks and icicles surround the work area, with rounded buildings behind them. The coloring sheet includes many small paw pads, Nick's floral shirt, and broad snow shapes.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Wearing Finnick's Junior Officer Sticker Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Nick Wilde wearing Finnick's junior officer sticker, pointing toward the star-centered shield on his shirt beside his diagonally striped necktie and collar. His other paw rests in a trouser pocket as his tail curves behind him. The coloring sheet keeps the background mostly blank around the full standing figure.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Holding Judy Hopps's Carrot Recorder Under the Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde holds Judy Hopps's carrot recorder under the bridge in this printable coloring page, lifting it beside his face while his other paw rests in his pocket. The bridge's curved stonework frames the skyline and water behind him. His striped tie, recorder clip, and outlined tail add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Crossing a Rainforest Rope Bridge with Judy Hopps Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde crossing a rainforest rope bridge with Judy Hopps, gripping the side rope as Judy follows him over wooden planks. Knotted railings frame their figures above a forested ravine with distant waterfalls. The coloring sheet includes broad leaf shapes, narrow rope sections, and their clothing details.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Riding a Rainforest Gondola with Judy Hopps Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde rides a rainforest gondola with Judy Hopps in this printable coloring page, sitting cross-legged beside her on a bench above dense trees and waterfalls. Another cable car hangs outside the large window behind them. The coloring sheet includes cabin supports, Nick's striped tie, Judy's knee pads, and small foliage outlines.

pages.title: Young Nick Wilde Wearing His Junior Ranger Scout Uniform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Nick Wilde wearing his Junior Ranger Scout uniform, saluting beside a campsite with a neckerchief and two buttoned chest pockets. Cargo shorts and a belt complete his outfit, with a pitched tent behind him. The coloring sheet includes broad tail sections, grass tufts, and small uniform fastenings.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Checking Traffic Cameras in Bellwether's Office Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde checks traffic cameras in Bellwether's office in this printable coloring page, pointing at a monitor showing a van traveling along a tree-lined city street. His other paw rests in his pocket beside a striped tie. The coloring sheet includes an arched window, desk panels, books, and a tufted chair.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Graduating From the Zootopia Police Academy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde graduating from the Zootopia Police Academy, standing in uniform as Judy Hopps fastens a shield badge to his chest. A tossed graduation cap appears above them beside the ceremony podium. The coloring sheet includes Nick's tie, belt pouches, Judy's knee pads, and broad tail sections.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Dancing with Judy Hopps at Gazelle's Concert Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde dances with Judy Hopps at Gazelle's concert in this printable coloring page, bending his knees and raising his paws beside Judy's matching dance pose. Gazelle performs between tall speakers beneath an arched lighting rig. Floating musical notes, Nick's striped tie, and Judy's uniform equipment add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Wearing Sunglasses at the City Hall Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde wearing sunglasses at the City Hall celebration, standing with one paw on his hip beneath strings of triangular bunting. His collared shirt and striped tie contrast with the broad trouser and tail areas. Tall columns and wide entrance steps provide architectural sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Attending Dr. Fuzzby's Partnership Class with Judy Hopps Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde attends Dr. Fuzzby's partnership class with Judy Hopps in this printable coloring page, sitting beside Judy while the small instructor gestures in front of them. Nick wears a floral shirt and tie, and Judy wears a sweater. Chairs, bookshelves, a potted plant, and an oval rug complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Undercover as a Dad at the Shipyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Nick Wilde undercover as a dad at the shipyard, wearing a baseball cap and front carrier with a small fox inside. Cargo shorts and rolled sleeves complete his disguise beside stacked containers. The coloring sheet includes carrier buckles, dock ropes, a ship's bow, and a crane lifting cargo.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Wearing a Tuxedo at the Zootennial Gala Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde wears a tuxedo at the Zootennial Gala in this printable coloring page, standing between tied curtains with a bow tie and flower on his lapel. A folded pocket square and small buttons detail the jacket and shirt. The coloring sheet combines broad suit panels with leafy floral arrangements and his sweeping tail.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Shielding Judy Hopps with a Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde shielding Judy Hopps with a portrait, holding its ornate frame while Judy crouches behind him in her gala gown. Nick wears a tuxedo and bow tie beneath a tall archway. The coloring sheet includes carved frame corners, the pictured animal's jewelry, and Judy's necklace and dress folds.

pages.title: Nick Wilde on a Giant Handbag in Fru Fru's Warehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde sits on a giant handbag in Fru Fru's warehouse in this printable coloring page, wearing a tuxedo while Fru Fru stands on another bag nearby. Rows of oversized purses fill the shelves behind them. The coloring sheet includes quilted diamond panels, large handles, buckles, hanging tags, and Fru Fru's small dress details.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Wearing a Bucket Hat at Marsh Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Nick Wilde wearing a bucket hat at Marsh Market, standing on a wooden dock in his floral shirt and striped necktie. Rope-wrapped posts and tall reeds border the scene, with a small boat on the water behind him. Shirt flowers and hat stitching detail the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Searching Weather Wall Catwalks for Judy Hopps Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde searches Weather Wall catwalks for Judy Hopps in this printable coloring page, gripping a railing while stepping along a grated walkway beside large industrial pipes. His floral shirt and striped tie stand out among the straight structural lines. The coloring sheet includes pipe collars, bolts, distant platforms, and broad tail sections.

pages.title: Nick Wilde Descending the Clocktower Stairs Into Reptile Ravine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde descending the clocktower stairs into Reptile Ravine, holding the curved railing beside an open arched doorway behind his shoulder. He wears a floral shirt and striped tie above plain trousers. Rounded towers, a high bridge, rocky cliffs, and palm-like plants fill the coloring sheet's background.

pages.title: Zootopia Nick Wilde in Neighborhood Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde relaxes in a neighborhood park in this printable coloring page, smiling with both hands in his pockets beneath a short-sleeved shirt and striped tie. His pointed ears and bushy tail stand out beside a park bench, rounded trees, bushes, and a path on this Zootopia fox coloring sheet.
